_help: ALL the words on the page live here. Links, names and the year are in site.config.json.
Any text can be a plain string or {"full": "...", "short": "..."}: phones (720px and under) show the short one.
{{brand}}, {{year}}, {{founderName}}, {{companyName}}, {{companyUrl}}, {{partnerName}}, {{partnerUrl}} and any other key from site.config.json can be used inside a text.
Lists are arrays: add, remove or reorder entries and the page follows. hero.rotating must have exactly 3 phrases (the CSS loop is tuned for 3).

hero.title: I design and build the systems behind

lead.full: Solution architect and software consultant with 8+ years shipping enterprise platforms on .NET, Azure, Shopify Plus, Dynamics 365 Commerce and Optimizely. I design commerce systems for businesses of every size, from a first online store to high-volume retail, then build them to last.

text.full: I’m Indumeet, a solution architect and software consultant based in Canada, working remotely with clients anywhere. For more than eight years I’ve designed and delivered enterprise systems in Canada and India, owning architecture decisions, leading technical initiatives and mentoring developers along the way.

items.q: What kind of engagements do you take on?
items.a: Architecture reviews and target designs, lead development on commerce and integration platforms, and fractional-architect roles alongside an existing team. Short or long, always remote-friendly.

items.q: Do you only work with large retailers?
items.a: No. Through {{companyName}} I also set up stores for new and growing businesses on Shopify, WooCommerce or Wix, and recommend the platform that fits your catalogue and budget.

items.q: Which platforms do you work with?
items.a: Shopify Plus, Dynamics 365 Commerce, Optimizely, WooCommerce and Wix on the commerce side; .NET and Azure for integrations and services.
Canada, working remotely with clients anywhere, with regular video check-ins.

items.q: What if the project needs a team?
items.a: {{companyName}} and partner {{partnerName}} provide developers, DevOps and app/game development, with me as architect.
Book a discovery call. We go through goals, constraints and existing systems, then you get a written proposal with scope and price.
